title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative:
The ICSP Programme, implemented by Trócaire and partners in the Manicaland, Matabeleland South and Masvingo provinces of Zimbabwe, works towards the goal that women and older adolescent girls experience increased safety, psychosocial wellbeing, and meaningful participation and leadership. This objective supports women, older adolescent girls and GBV survivors to use GBV specialised interventions and psychosocial support to meet their needs and preferences. Activities include awareness raising sessions on GBV prevention and referrals; engaging boys and men on topics of power and gender equity; and the provision of counselling and legal support to GBV survivors. The principal focus of this outcome is:
Women’s protection and access to specialised GBV supports
